name: Celestial Amber Canopy
description: A vast canopy of amber‑glowing leaves suspended in a twilight sky, each leaf pulsing like a heartbeat.
prompt: A breathtaking aerial view of an enormous canopy made of translucent amber leaves, glowing warm gold and orange, suspended among soft clouds at twilight. The leaves emit a gentle pulse of light, casting a warm glow on the mist below. Hyper‑realistic, cinematic lighting, 8k resolution, wide angle.
caption: When the sky wears amber, the world feels a little warmer. ✨
